_comment_ignoreCommand: Skip preview builds for Dependabot branches. A breaking major bump (@noble/curves 2.x changed its export paths) failed the preview build and emailed a deploy failure on 2026-06-22. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml: tsc --noEmit on every PR) still gates correctness, and production (main) + real feature branches still build. exit 0 = skip build, exit 1 = build.
ignoreCommand: case "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" in dependabot/*) exit 0;; *) exit 1;; esac
